description: Use this to change a stored inbox rule. Requires auth and message_update. Replacing actions with forward_to or auto_reply, or enabling a disabled rule that has them, also needs message_send. HTTP 403 permission_denied with param actions otherwise. Disabling a rule or removing those actions stays on message_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), rule_id (required), and any of name, enabled, position, conditions, actions, stop_processing. Omitted fields stay as they are. forward_to is checked again. Returns the updated inbox_rule. An unknown rule is HTTP 404 rule_not_found. A bad body is HTTP 400 invalid_rule. A disallowed forward_to is HTTP 400 forward_target_not_allowed.

actions.description: Replacement actions. Replaces the stored object.

conditions.description: Replacement conditions. Replaces the stored object.

enabled.description: Turn the rule on or off.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

position.description: Replacement sort key. Lower numbers run first.

stop_processing.description: Whether a match stops later rules.

name: cooper_update_rule
title: Update inbox rule
